scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street with tall buildings on both sides, lined with pedestrians and vehicles. The buildings have a beige color with balconies and windows. People are walking along the sidewalk, some carrying bags or pushing strollers. A few motorcycles are parked along the curb. The sky is overcast.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings are multi-story structures with balconies and windows. They appear to be residential or commercial properties. Some have a more modern look while others seem older.
scene_analysis.materials: The ground is paved with gray concrete blocks. There are also cobblestone sidewalks and asphalt roads. The streetlights are mounted on poles.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk. Some are made of metal, while others are plastic.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are small trees and bushes planted along the sidewalk. They add a touch of greenery to the otherwise urban landscape.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted on the buildings and along the street. They display information such as street names, business names, and directions.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: People are walking in both directions, some alone and in groups. They seem to be going about their daily business.
scene_analysis.as_resident: Some residents can be seen sitting on benches or walking with children. Others are shopping or eating at outdoor cafes.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The streets are clean and well-maintained, with clear signage and pedestrian crossings.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The area is popular among tourists, with many shops and restaurants catering to visitors.
scene_analysis.as_student: Students are working on assignments or studying. Some are taking breaks to explore the area.
